blindSummary: This state/province sits among the areas where a national LGBTI rights organisation's 2025 report finds 'territorial expansion of violence': killings spread outward while state response stayed insufficient. No unit-specific ordinance, statute or enforcement series was found beyond its place in the per-unit counts - recorded as counts, not as local findings. National context attached to this record: one LGBTIQ+ person was killed every 32 hours in 2025, a 63% increase over 2024 (270 vs 164 killings); 18% of the 164 homicides in 2024 were trans women; the state ombudsman counted at least 25 trans women murdered Jan-Sep 2025.
blindSourceSummaries: National newspaper (14 Apr 2025) on the killing of a 32-year-old trans woman in a mid-sized city: she was beaten and thrown into a creek, died of her injuries, onlookers filmed instead of helping; the third such killing in that city in 2025; 13 trans people killed nationally in Q1 2025. National context - no specific content for this unit.

An international news outlet (6 Aug 2025): follow-up to the viral video of the trans woman's killing - the video shocked the country but the killings continued, by armed gangs; it frames being queer in parts of the country as 'to sign your own death sentence'. National context.

An international newspaper (30 Jul 2024): armed groups threatening a wave of 'social cleansing' against trans women in another unit - a 51-year-old woman given a week to leave or be killed, twice displaced; 41 trans women killed in the country in 2023, 8 killed Feb-Apr 2024; flyers circulating by WhatsApp list 'faggots, lesbians and men and women who destroy homes' as legitimate military targets. National armed-group context; this unit's own exposure in the record is homicide expansion, not this armed-group pattern.
blindTangential: The country's armed-group 'social cleansing' campaigns (a 2024 flyer pattern) name gays, lesbians and trans women alike, so LGB-wide hostility from non-state armed actors is part of the national climate a visitor moves through.
